title: Distribution tail of the distance to infinity in supercritical bond percolation
summary: We give an estimate for the distribution tail of the passage time between $0$ and $\infty$ in first-passage percolation on $\mathbb Z^d$, when the weight distribution is bounded and has a supercritical atom at $0$. A special case involves the number of disjoint cutsets between $0$ and $\infty$ in supercritical bond percolation. Besides, we show that the rate function for the upper-tail deviations of the point-to-point passage time is asymptotically polynomial near $0$.
